home.title: Envelopes
home.desc: Documents you sent for signature and the ones waiting for you.
home.search: Search by title, name or email
home.noMatch: Nothing matches. Try another box or other words.
home.emptyBody: Upload a PDF, add who signs and in what order, place their fields and send it.

errors.network: No connection. Check your network and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended or you do not have Sign in this workspace.
errors.not_found: Not found, or you cannot see it.
errors.forbidden: Only the sender or an admin can do this.
errors.invalid_input: Check the fields and try again.
errors.envelope_locked: This envelope was already sent and cannot change. Void it and copy it to a new draft.
errors.pdf_invalid: That file is not a PDF we can read.
errors.pdf_encrypted: The PDF is password protected. Remove the password and upload it again.
errors.pdf_pages: The PDF has more than 100 pages.
errors.pdf_too_large: The PDF is larger than 4 MB.
errors.pdf_unicode: This page uses characters the PDF fonts cannot show. Export it from Docs with your browser and upload the PDF.
errors.storage_unavailable: File storage is not configured on this server.
errors.file_unavailable: The file could not be read. Try again later.
errors.too_many_recipients: An envelope takes up to 50 recipients.
errors.recipient_email: Check the email of every recipient.
errors.invalid_field: One field is outside the document.
errors.dropdown_options: A dropdown needs at least one option.
errors.invalid_field_recipient: Every field must belong to a signer or an approver.
errors.too_many_fields: An envelope takes up to 500 fields.
errors.not_ready: The envelope is not ready to send yet.
errors.invalid_state: That is not possible in the current status.
errors.void_first: Void the envelope before deleting it.
errors.not_your_turn: It is not your turn to sign yet.
errors.docs_unavailable: You do not have Docs in this workspace.
errors.crm_not_found: That CRM record does not exist or you cannot see it.
errors.hiring_unavailable: You do not have Hiring in this workspace.
errors.offer_not_approved: The offer has to be approved first.
errors.role_unfilled: Fill in a name and email for every role.
errors.no_signer_role: The template needs a signer role.
errors.csv_header: The CSV needs a header with name and email.
errors.invalid_roles: Check the roles: each needs a name and a different key.
errors.invalid_row: missing name or a valid email
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes.
errors.otp_required: Enter the code we emailed you first.
errors.otp_locked: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.
errors.otp_expired: The code expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.otp_not_required: This envelope does not need a code.
errors.field_not_yours: That field belongs to another recipient.
errors.duplicate_recipient: The same person is twice with the same role.
errors.state_waiting: It is not your turn yet.
errors.pdf_too_complex: This PDF is too complex to process safely (too many objects, too much nesting or compressed data that grows too much). Print it to a new PDF and upload that.
errors.pdf_unsupported: This PDF uses a compression we do not accept. Print it to a new PDF and upload that.
errors.admin_only: Only an admin can delete a completed envelope.
errors.document_changed: The stored document does not match the one that was sent. Nothing was signed; contact support.
errors.bulk_daily_cap: Bulk send is limited to 1,000 envelopes a day per workspace.

new.title: New envelope
new.desc: Start from a PDF, a Docs page or a template.
new.fromCrm: Linked to {label} in the CRM. The signed PDF is attached there when everyone signs.
new.fileHint: Up to {mb} MB and 100 pages. Scripts, actions, forms and attachments inside the PDF are removed.
new.docsHint: The page becomes a PDF with the access you have in Docs.
new.docsUnavailable: You do not have Docs in this workspace.
new.crmRecipient: {name} is added as the first signer.

editor.documentReplaced: Document replaced. Fields on missing pages were removed.
editor.draftDesc: Draft. Nothing reaches anyone until you send it.
editor.name: Name
editor.rolesHelp: Signers sign their fields. Approvers approve, with or without fields. People who receive a copy get the signed PDF at the end. In order, the same number signs at the same time.
editor.otp: Ask recipients for a code sent to their email before they open the document
editor.fieldCount: {n, plural, =0 {no fields} one {# field} other {# fields}}
editor.immutable: Once sent, the envelope cannot change. To fix something, void it and copy it to a new draft.
editor.deleteBody: The draft and its document are deleted. Nobody received anything yet.

problems.no_signers: Add at least one signer or approver.
problems.duplicate_recipient: The same person is twice with the same role.

legal.short: Electronic signature with an audit trail (simple electronic signature, ESIGN and UETA style). Not an advanced or qualified signature under eIDAS, nor a "firma digital" under Argentine Law 25.506.

fields.noParties: Add a signer or an approver first.
fields.placeHint: Click on the document where the {kind} field goes.
fields.pickHint: Pick a field type, then click on the document. Drag to move, use the corner to resize, arrows to nudge and Delete to remove.
fields.autoHint: Filled in when the person signs.
fields.label: Label
fields.sideEmpty: Select a field to change it.
fields.count: {n, plural, =0 {no fields} one {# field} other {# fields}}
fields.placeOnPage: Place the {kind} field on page {page}: press Enter

detail.linkRotated: New link sent. The previous one no longer works.
detail.certificateNote: The last pages are the certificate of completion.
detail.hashHelp: Compute the SHA-256 of a copy to check that it is the same file.
detail.voidBody: The links stop working and the recipients who got one receive your reason. Signatures already made stay in the timeline.
detail.deleteBody: The envelope, its files and its timeline are deleted for good. Recipients keep the copies they received.
detail.deleteCompleted: This is a completed, signed record. Deleting it removes the signed PDF and the audit trail from Sign for good.

templates.desc: Documents with roles and fields you send again and again.
templates.emptyBody: Save a document with its roles and fields once, then send it to anyone or to a CSV list.
templates.bulkHelp: One envelope per row, up to {max} a day. The CSV needs a header with name and email: each row fills the {role} role. The other roles below are the same for every envelope. It goes out in batches; sending the same list again does not duplicate envelopes.
templates.bulkSent: {n, plural, one {# envelope sent} other {# envelopes sent}}.
templates.bulkUnavailable: Bulk send needs a document and a signer role.
templates.deleteBody: Envelopes already created from it are not affected.

viewer.error: The document could not be shown. Reload the page to try again.

adopt.drawHint: Draw with your mouse, finger or pen.
adopt.uploadLabel: Image of your signature (PNG or JPEG)
adopt.legal: By adopting it, you agree that this mark is your electronic signature for this document.
adopt.empty: Write, draw or upload your signature first.

done.title: Thanks, you are done
done.body: Your part is saved. When everyone signs, you get the signed PDF by email.

waiting.title: Not your turn yet
waiting.body: You get an email when it is your turn to sign.

completed.title: Everyone signed
completed.body: The envelope is complete. The signed PDF with its certificate was emailed to every recipient.

declined.title: This envelope was declined
declined.body: Someone declined to sign it, so nobody else can sign it. The sender was told why.

voided.title: This envelope was voided
voided.body: The sender voided it. Nothing else needs to be done.

expired.title: This envelope expired
expired.body: Ask the sender to send it again.

public.legal: Electronic signature with an audit trail (simple electronic signature). Your IP address, browser and the time of each step are recorded in the certificate of completion.

otp.title: Confirm it is you
otp.body: {name}, we will send a 6-digit code to {email} before you open the document.
otp.sent: We sent a code to {email}. It works for 10 minutes.

public.attemptsLeft: {n, plural, one {# try left} other {# tries left}}.
public.consent: I agree to use electronic records and signatures for this document.
public.consentHelp: You can ask the sender for a paper copy instead. Your electronic signature has the same effect as a handwritten one where the law allows it.
public.consentFirst: Check the box to agree to sign electronically first.
public.approveHint: Review the document and approve it.
public.remaining: {n, plural, =0 {All required fields are done} one {# required field left} other {# required fields left}}
public.missing: {n, plural, one {# required field is empty.} other {# required fields are empty.}}
public.declineBody: The envelope ends for everyone and the sender gets your reason.

noAccess.title: You cannot open this signed document
noAccess.body: Only the person who sent it, the workspace admins and its recipients can see it in Sign. Ask the sender for a copy.
